blocks.text: 123 | Musaph for the New Year | 123

He will reign. The glory of His kingdom, the holiness of His course, will be apparent to all when He completes His work and will reign. He will fold up the skies and unfold new skies on the day appointed by lot for Him from Zion to reign. The nations falter, the proud clamour, the arrogant fall when the exalted One comes to reign. Then those compared to the fish of the sea (Israel) shall rule, their multitude will be raised up when the King of nations comes forth to reign. The noblest of the peoples shall be gathered from among the peoples to bring the smallest of peoples to their place where He will reign. They will chant pleasant songs before them whom He has lifted up from among the peoples so that over them He may reign. The idols of Sikkut, the abominations

blocks.text: ככתוב As it is written in Thy holy words: a beautiful branch, the delight of the whole earth, the mountain of Zion, the stronghold of the North, the city of the great King.

פני The light of the moon and of the sun wilt Thou cause to blush and those who worship them will be put to shame when Thou dost lift up the kingdom. Glorify the city of beauty, that it may be bright as the sun and reveal in front of us the glory of the kingdom.
ככתוב As it is written through Thy prophet: and the moon shall blush and the sun be ashamed, for the Lord of Hosts rules on Mount Zion and in Jerusalem and in front of His elders there is glory.

of Kiyun, are dragged along as if slain, they are cast down so that they may not reign. O assembly of the Supreme God, do homage, you sons of the powerful (forefathers), offer singing and praise to the Lord for He will reign. When He lifts His strong hand to raise up His prince and exalts those He has carried, He will be powerful and reign. When He raises His hand above the high heavens, on the splendour of His throne He will be seated and reign. The earth is shaken by destruction and ruin, in which dwellers on earth will be ensnared when He will rage and reign. Three times will He make sound the dread of powerful Shofar blasts and them will He favour, they will cause glory to rise from the end of the earth, for He will reign. Beauty from the earth will ascend and glory from the sea, exultation from the heavens above, they will all rejoice when He will reign.
